actor_population.observed: each iteration reads a runtime-array byte, skips bit 20 entries, uses low 5 bits as an index into the team data path, then advances actor and source positions

limitations: The arrays are runtime state and may be modified after initialization; this does not freeze a final formation or lineup.
The low-five-bit index and bit-20 behavior are structural observations, not player-number or event semantics.
No web roster movement or actor spawning behavior is changed from this extraction alone.
